g.text: Stage 1 (tag: stage-1), base setting. Scenario: Customer #3 (Pasta) from arrival on turn 7 to payment, and the manager's turn-10 choice
Every message is a call in src/ (GameController, TurnMgr, Waiter, Chef, Cashier, Restaurant)
Shown: every call that changes state, makes a
decision or passes a value used later.
Omitted: getters used only to build display
Step 1 · Arrivals, then the start-of-turn display
[a factory is registered for this turn (1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16)]
staffList = [w, chef], so the loop is drawn unrolled:
iteration 1 = w (Waiter acts first), iteration 2 = chef
badly formed text is re-prompted here
rule checks are left to the domain
B: "seat 4" instead → #3 falls to 60 and the
delay cascades → VICTORY at the 4-paid minimum
no state change; message "Waiter waits this turn."
the exception leaves perform() at once:
markActed() is never reached, so the Waiter's task is NOT used up
the loop asks again and the manager types "wait"
Steps 2-3 · Chef acts second (may cook an order taken this turn)
(a programming error; the Chef already checked)
no state change; "Chef waits this turn."
markActed() is never reached: the Chef's task is not used up
returns a new list, so customers can be
[for each e : events of steps 4 and 5]
[paid >= 4 and revenue >= 4500 and avg present and avg >= 60]
